_readme: Review coverage ledger (#3936, ReviewCoveragePassDesign §2, §4). Each key is the sha256 of one declaration's code with comments and spacing removed (contracts/script/review-coverage.mjs hashes). Each entry holds marks only: reader and reviewer are opaque review numbers, commit is the commit the hash was taken at, and readerThread / fixThread / recordedAt feed the entry check. Never a finding or a description. Written by the tool, checked in CI: an entry whose hash matches no declaration at its commit is refused.
